Complex HTML Document

This document tests advanced HTML features including CSS styling, tables, code blocks, and blockquotes.

Table Support

Row 1, Col 1 Row 1, Col 2 Row 1, Col 3
Row 2, Col 1 Row 2, Col 2 Row 2, Col 3

Code Blocks

Below is a standard code block styled with CSS.

function greet(name) {
  return `Hello, ${name}!`;
}
console.log(greet("World"));

Blockquotes

This is a blockquote. It should be indented and styled appropriately in the output format.

It can span multiple paragraphs.
